title: work_overworld_session_job rejects with 'Choose one option...' but… @ albany_city
excerpts: work_overworld_session_job rejects with 'Choose one option...' but job_scenes/job_choices never exposed the options, even after satisfying the visible contact/POI prerequisites.
Job discovered and listed but work_overworld_session_job always rejected it needing an option; no job_choices ever appeared to supply one.
Job requires an option_id but no job_scenes/job_choices data was ever exposed to select one, making it permanently unplayable.
